reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope-resolved pulse tracking, regeneration-step interruption/restoration and defined reconstitution with carbon balance.

checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of prior primary Methods/supplements or validated tracer, inhibitor and reconstitution protocols with detailed-condition transfer checks.
No specified tissue/isolated-organelle system or concrete analytical platform; proposed generic material and analytical identification requirements do not identify an executable preparation route.
Lists unknown buffer/temperature/enzyme/substrate/timing settings to establish from pilots but lacks a concrete preparation recipe or calibration-to-choice procedure for those conditions.
Measurement recovery/uncertainty dimensions are named, but no defined accuracy gate or rule deriving acceptable closure and recovery from the calibration data.
Primary normalized carbon contrast is specified, but no explicit amount/time unit convention or rules for below-limit/missing isotope/pool measurements.
Dose and time pilots are proposed without a bounded grid or explicit range-selection/stopping criterion before locking the confirmatory design.
Initial held-out testing is good; after an ambiguous result and changed label/perturbation no refreeze and fresh independent confirmation is required.
No sample/raw-file linkage and exact isotope-model/code/software/settings provenance for independent audit.

Excellent scientific separation of repeated net recycling, exchange, activation and finite pools, including convertible initial reservoirs. Prospective sham/inactive/omission/enzyme-rescue controls; independent nested preparation precision planning, randomized coded assessment and technical stopping; explicit paired contrast/CIs/identifiability and held-out alternative models. Diagnostic repair and conditional null/ambiguous decisions are sound. Defined enzyme omission/restoration, purity/bypass tests and auxiliary-system accounting provide an independent causal validation route once prerequisites are resolved.
